item.title: Why Ohio scientists - and some dairy producers - are against legalizing raw milk
item.description: The sale of raw milk has been banned in Ohio since 1997, with some exceptions. But some lawmakers want to change that.

item.title: A forecast shows shoppers will bring the festive holiday season to Ohio's retailers
item.description: Consumer sentiment is at a 10 year low. But Ohio’s retailers are still expecting a good holiday season this year.

item.title: A statewide conservation effort is saving Ohio’s ‘snot otters,’ eastern hellbenders
item.description: Eastern hellbenders once hid across southern and central Ohio, but decades of habitat loss and water pollution have left them endangered.

item.title: Ohio Republicans vote to eliminate the four-day grace period for mail-in ballots
item.description: GOP state lawmakers approved a bill that wipes out extra time for mail-in ballots to arrive, except for military and overseas voters.

item.description: State regulators hit FirstEnergy with a quarter of a billion dollars in penalties related to its actions from the billion-dollar bailout law.

item.description: Four property tax bills passed that Republican sponsors say add up to $2 billion in tax relief for homeowners.
